description: This file defines a functional interface JwtAuthenticationResultProvider responsible for extracting AuthenticationResult objects from JSON Web Tokens within the context of the Ditto services gateway security authentication.

classes.name: JwtAuthenticationResultProvider
classes.description: A functional interface for extracting AuthenticationResult from a JsonWebToken.

methods.name: getAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Extracts an AuthenticationResult from the provided JsonWebToken and DittoHeaders.
